title: wg: protocol-06 §10.2 franking_signature_key vs franking_agent
description: Erratum. §10.2 (L3321-3325) registers component 0x0021 as "franking_signature_key"; §5.4 (L1652, L1669, L1752) calls the component franking_agent, and franking_signature_key is a field inside FrankingAgentData. mimid treats them as one component 0x0021 (decision mimid-1wgh.4.18). Fix: register it as franking_agent.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED editorial: §10.2 registers franking_signature_key, component is franking_agent. Editorial PR.

Editorial part in PR https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/pull/164
